about: The output schema each release from v1.135.2 advertised for the tools a platform with no database registers, recorded where it changed: a release is listed with the schemas that differ from the release before it. A client caches a tool list across an upgrade and validates every later result against it, so a result must pass each of these (#1971, #2216). Recorded from each tag's own build of the platform TestEveryPastOutputSchemaAcceptsTheResult assembles.

error.description: Machine-readable error envelope; present only when the call failed. Branch on error.code / error.category rather than parsing the message prose.

category.description: error category the caller can branch on (e.g. client_input, internal)

code.description: stable snake_case error code (e.g. not_found, unauthorized)

hint.description: corrective guidance for the caller, when available

retry_after_seconds.description: seconds after which the same call is expected to be admitted; present only on a rate_limited refusal
